trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to chase. Plan the whole run around it instead — clear the missable trophies while the story still allows them, then sweep the collectibles and counters in free roam.

steps.text: Confirm the full list of 54 other trophies and their grades before you start
Clear every missable trophy during the story, before any point of no return
Cross off the remaining collectibles, activities and counters in free roam after the finale
Let the platinum pop automatically when the last of the 54 lands

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the game's first story beat, so simply starting a new game and following the markers earns it — it cannot be missed on a normal playthrough.

steps.text: Start a new game and take control in the opening scene
Follow the Gone Fishing objectives until the mission-complete screen
Let the trophy register before you move on to Chapter 1

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that makes up Chapter 1. The trophy lands when the chapter closes, so keep pushing the main story markers rather than wandering off — side content stays available afterwards.

steps.text: Work through the Chapter 1 mission chain in order
Use the story markers on the map to find each next mission
Play the chapter's final mission to its completion screen

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete the whole of Chapter 2. As with every chapter trophy, it pops when the chapter's last mission ends, and nothing in the chapter needs a special setup — just finish the story missions as they unlock.

steps.text: Finish the opening missions of Chapter 2 as they appear
Keep following the main story thread to the chapter finale
Complete the final Chapter 2 mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 from its first mission to its last. By now the map is opening up, but the chapter trophy only asks for the story chain — detours into activities and collectibles can wait for free roam.

steps.text: Start Chapter 3 from the story marker after Chapter 2 closes
Complete each Chapter 3 mission in sequence
Finish the chapter's closing mission to earn the trophy

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in full. Before you start its final missions, check the missable audit in this tracker: several side strands close as the story advances, and Chapter 4 is a good moment to finish them.

steps.text: Clear any open side strands you want done before the chapter finale
Play the Chapter 4 missions in order
Complete the last mission of Chapter 4

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a separate save from just before it: afterwards you return to free roam for the 100% cleanup, and a pre-finale save is your safety net if any side strand closed earlier than expected.

steps.text: Save in a spare slot before starting the final mission
Make sure every missable in the audit is already earned
Play the final mission to the credits
Confirm the gold trophy registers at the mission-complete screen

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. It is a named story mission rather than a side errand, so it arrives on the main path — play it through to the completion screen.

steps.text: Reach the point in the story where Breakfast Run unlocks
Start the mission from its marker and follow the objectives
Finish the run and let the mission close out

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist, the big set-piece robbery of the story. Prepare like any heist: arrive with full health, armour and ammo, then play the job through its getaway to the completion screen.

steps.text: Unlock The Cartel Heist in the story and start it from its marker
Stock up on armour, snacks and ammunition before the job begins
Play the heist through the escape and lose the heat
Finish the mission debrief so the completion registers

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play when it unlocks. It sits among the activity-style story jobs, so watch for its marker as the chapters advance and play it to the end rather than leaving it half done.

steps.text: Reach the story point where Child's Play becomes available
Start the mission and follow each objective in turn
Complete the final objective so the mission closes

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Like the other named jobs in this part of the list, it is earned by finishing the mission itself — no score attack or optional objective is required, just a clean completion.

steps.text: Unlock Headliners and travel to its start marker
Work through the mission objectives in order
Reach the mission-complete screen

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Expect a loud job: bring a fast car for the approach and a heavy weapon for the takedown itself, then finish the escape the mission asks for.

steps.text: Start VCIA Takedown from its mission marker
Bring a fast vehicle and heavy firepower for the airport job
Complete the takedown and the escape that follows it
Let the mission close out so the trophy registers

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Treat it as a combat operation: go in with full armour and your best loadout, use cover through the firefights, and play it through to the extraction or closing objective.

steps.text: Unlock Operation Savage Glory and start it from its marker
Equip armour and a strong all-round loadout beforehand
Push through the operation's combat objectives using cover
Complete the closing objective to finish the mission

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own completion tracker. That means the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the counted grinds together — use the in-game checklist categories as your map and this tracker to tick off each family as it closes.

steps.text: Finish the main story and every stranger strand
Complete each activity family at least to its checklist requirement
Sweep the collectible sets and exploration until no category shows a gap
Check the in-game completion percentage and hunt the last missing items
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

steps.text: Push the tracker to exactly 100% for the gold trophy

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, flips and near-miss style feats the game counts as stunts. The efficient route is to find a few reliable stunt spots, such as ramps and jump lines you can repeat cleanly, and farm them in batches instead of hunting 250 unique locations.

steps.text: Learn what the game counts as a stunt by landing your first few cleanly
Pick repeatable stunt spots with a safe landing and a short reset run
Farm the spots in batches, checking your stunt count in the stats
Keep going until the counter reaches 250

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every type of activity the game offers at least once — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest of the activity families on the map. You only need a first attempt at each, not a win, so tour the activity icons and try one of everything.

steps.text: Open the map and note each distinct activity icon family
Visit one activity of each type and play a first round of it
Tick each family off in this tracker as you try it
Try the last remaining activity type to complete the set

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn one range at a time: memorise where its targets appear, use the weapon class the challenge is built around, and retry immediately while the layout is fresh — gold is about accuracy streaks, not speed alone.

steps.text: Find each Shooting Range and open its challenge list
Practise a challenge until you know its target pattern
Replay it cleanly, prioritising accuracy over raw speed, until you take gold
Repeat for every challenge on every range

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every race location on the map. One win per location is enough: learn each course's tight gates first with a practice run, then race it for real, cutting the racing line through checkpoints instead of chasing top speed on the straights.

steps.text: Locate every Top Fun drone race start point on the map
Fly a practice lap to learn each course's gates and turns
Race each course and take first place once
Tick off locations in this tracker until none remain

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — distinct events, not the same race twenty times. Spread your entries across the map's race series, bring a car that suits each class, and count a race only once you have actually taken first place in it.

steps.text: Enter races from the different race series around Leonida
Match your vehicle to each race's class and terrain
Win a race, then move to a different event rather than repeating it
Reach 20 distinct race wins

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge. Accept the challenge when Cal offers it, then fish the target spot properly: cast where the fish are showing, work the reel steadily instead of hauling, and land the better catch before the challenge timer ends.

steps.text: Meet Cal and accept his fishing challenge
Use the bait and spot the challenge points you to
Hook and land fish carefully without snapping the line
Finish the challenge with the better result than Cal

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Find a cabinet in an arcade or bar, start a game and play it through to its end screen — winning is not the point, finishing a full game is.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in the world
Start any of the cabinet's games
Play it through to its game-over or completion screen

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Andy's strand belongs to the story's supporting cast, and strands like his close when the main story ends — finish his final mission before you play the last story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. Work his missions as they appear instead of banking them for later: a character strand only offers its final mission after the earlier ones are done, and the strand can close when the story moves on.

steps.text: Take Andy's missions as each one unlocks
Follow his strand through to its final mission marker
Complete the final mission before finishing the main story
Confirm the trophy lands at the mission-complete screen

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton's strand can close as the main story reaches its end — complete his final mission before the finale rather than leaving it for the post-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Keep his missions current as the story advances: do each one when it appears so the finale of his strand unlocks in good time, then finish it before the main story's closing missions.

steps.text: Do Kenton's missions in order as they unlock
Reach and start his final mission
Complete it before you finish the main story
Let the mission close out so the trophy registers

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Billy's strand is one of the side stories the ending can shut off — finish his final mission before the last story missions, not after them.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Treat his missions as part of the main routine: whenever a new one appears on the map, clear it before pushing the chapters, so his final mission is done well before the story's end.

steps.text: Complete Billy's earlier missions as they appear
Unlock and start his final mission
Finish it ahead of the story finale
Confirm the trophy at the completion screen

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: A strand only counts when it is completed in full, and strands can close as the story advances — finish eight complete strands before the final missions instead of leaving several half done.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Meeting a stranger is not enough: each strand is a short chain, and only finishing the chain counts. Spread them across the state and finish strands one at a time so none are left dangling when the story ends.

steps.text: Start stranger strands from their markers across the map
Finish one strand completely before starting the next
Keep a count of completed strands in this tracker
Complete the eighth full strand for the silver trophy

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Randy's strand closes with the story's end like the other character strands — his final mission has to be done before the finale, not in the post-game cleanup.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. His missions build on each other, so clear them as they unlock; once the strand's final mission is available, prioritise it over new story chapters.

steps.text: Work through Randy's missions as they unlock
Start his final mission when it appears
Complete it before the main story ends
Confirm the trophy registers on completion

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's strand can be shut off by the story's ending — finish his final mission while the strand is still open, before the last story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Keep pace with his missions as the chapters advance so the strand's finale unlocks early, then close it out before you commit to the main story's endgame.

steps.text: Complete Tyrone's missions in order as they appear
Take on his final mission when it unlocks
Finish it ahead of the story's final missions
Let the completion screen register the trophy

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are fixed world locations, so this is a travel sweep: visit each one, use the meditate prompt, and move on — they stay available in free roam, which makes this a relaxed post-story cleanup item.

steps.text: Find a meditation spot and use its meditate prompt
Note which regions of the map you have already covered
Travel region by region so no spot is left behind
Meditate at the final spot to complete the set

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: The hunt is part of Bret's strand, and his missions close when the story ends — take the hunt and finish it before the final story missions.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Accept his hunt, track the animal in its territory, and bring it down cleanly — a unique animal means one specific quarry, so follow Bret's directions rather than hunting at random.

steps.text: Take the hunting job from Bret
Travel to the animal's territory and pick up its trail
Track and hunt the unique animal
Report back to Bret to close the job before the story ends

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you travel rather than in one sweep, and focus your hunting on the missing cards of nearly finished sets — a set only counts when every card in it is yours.

steps.text: Pick up every collectible card you pass while exploring
Check which sets are closest to complete and hunt their missing cards
Complete the first full set, then the second
Finish the third set for the silver trophy

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK interaction at 100 different locations. These spots are spread across the whole state, so treat it as a background sweep: whenever you are near a fresh location, stop and WAiNK It, and let the count build as you work on everything else.

steps.text: Use the WAiNK interaction at the first location you find
Stop at new locations as you travel between missions
Watch the tracked count climb in the game stats
Reach the hundredth distinct location

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges unlock through ordinary play across every system — driving, combat, exploration, activities — so keep a varied routine and finish the short ones as they appear instead of grinding a single category.

steps.text: Open the challenges list and see which are already in progress
Finish the nearly complete challenges first
Play a spread of activities so new challenges keep unlocking
Complete your fiftieth challenge

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: It needs both partners together in the same escape, and the two of you only roam as a pair during parts of the story — do it in an early stretch where you are travelling together, before the story separates you.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Start the trouble somewhere with an escape route — near tunnels, alleys or a vehicle swap — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear while you are still together.

steps.text: Wait for a stretch of the story where you roam with your partner
Commit crimes until the wanted level reaches four stars
Break line of sight and hide until the stars start to fade
Lose the wanted level entirely while still with your partner

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: The chain needs your partner with you and a wanted level that never drops — the attempt belongs in the early partner sections, and a chain broken by losing the heat or the partner means starting over.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. Pick a tight cluster of shops, park for a fast exit, rob the first, and move straight to the next before the heat fades — the chain breaks if your wanted level is lost between shops.

steps.text: Find three shops close together during a partner section
Rob the first shop with your partner and take the money
Drive straight to the second shop without losing the wanted level
Rob the third shop to complete the back-to-back chain

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you get in and drive it, so make a habit of hopping into anything new you see parked or in traffic — different districts and different times of day put different models on the road.

steps.text: Get into and drive every new vehicle model you spot
Visit different districts to find different traffic and parked cars
Check dealerships and car meets for models traffic rarely spawns
Keep going until 100 vehicles are discovered

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus. Set it up before you trigger it: start a fight somewhere five or more enemies are grouped — a gang spot or a mission firefight — weaken your aim onto the group, then trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends.

steps.text: Find a fight with at least five enemies in one area
Position yourself with a clear line on the whole group
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it expires
Retry on the next group if the count falls short

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: VCIA access comes and goes with the story, so the departure has to happen during a window when you can get into the airport — leave it until later chapters and the chance may be gone.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, get into the airport and take off in an aircraft you were never scheduled to fly. While you have access to VCIA, reach a plane on the airfield, get aboard and get airborne; the trophy is about the unauthorised exit, not a clean flight plan.

steps.text: Enter VCIA during a part of the story when you have access
Reach an aircraft on the airfield
Take the aircraft and get airborne without authorisation
Clear the airport so the departure counts

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the army's tanks, and the description's joke is about ending up in one: get yourself into a Rhino and survive the experience. Military hardware shows up around bases and high-heat responses, so provoke or visit the places tanks patrol, board one, and make your escape before it is destroyed around you.

steps.text: Find where Rhinos appear — military ground and the highest wanted responses
Reach a Rhino and climb in
Drive it out of the hot zone before it takes fatal damage
Lose the heat once you are clear

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Case the store first: note the staff, the cameras and the quietest way in and out, then go in stealthily, take the goods without raising an alarm, and leave before anyone knows you were there.

steps.text: Choose a jewelry store and watch how it is staffed and guarded
Enter quietly, staying out of sight lines and camera view
Take the jewelry without triggering any alarm
Slip out and leave the area still undetected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. A vault job is the loud end of robbery: plan the exit before you go in, grab the vault's take under pressure, and have a fast car or a route change ready so the escape sticks — a robbery only counts once you have actually got away.

steps.text: Scout a bank and plan your escape route before entering
Rob the vault and take its contents
Escape and lose the heat so the robbery counts
Repeat at four more banks for five vaults in total

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape with the take. Stop or disable the truck fast — block its route with a heavy vehicle — crack the rear doors, grab the money and be gone before the response arrives; the escape is part of the trophy, not an afterthought.

steps.text: Spot an armoured truck on its route and move to intercept
Block and disable the truck with a heavy vehicle
Open the rear doors and take the money
Escape and lose the heat

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole state of Leonida until no part of the map is left unvisited. Work region by region — the cities, the keys, the swamps and the far corners — and use a mix of car, boat and aircraft so water and islands count too, checking the map for any patch you have not uncovered.

steps.text: Open the map and identify the regions you have not visited
Sweep one region at a time by road
Cover the water and outlying islands by boat or aircraft
Visit the last uncovered area to complete the state

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in the state. Every gang runs its own operations, so one robbery per gang is the whole job: hit an operation, note which gang it belonged to, and work through the list until every gang has been robbed once.

steps.text: Find an illegal operation and identify the gang that runs it
Rob the operation and get clear
Record the gang in this tracker so you do not repeat it
Rob one operation of each remaining gang

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: This is an early-game moment tied to Ocean Beach at the start of the story — stop for the cocktail during the opening stretch, before the story carries you away from it.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Early on, when you are on Ocean Beach, find the bar or drinks spot overlooking the water and order a cocktail there — it is a small scene-setting moment, so slow down and take it while the game first puts you on that beach.

steps.text: Reach Ocean Beach during the opening part of the game
Find the bar spot with a view over the beach
Order and enjoy the cocktail there
Let the moment play out so the trophy registers

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a car. Walk into a showroom, get into one of the display vehicles, and drive it straight out through the showroom glass — the exit through the window is the whole point, so do not use the door.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom on foot
Get into one of the vehicles on display
Accelerate straight through the showroom glass to the street
Drive clear of the showroom

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play the bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and complete the follow-through the trophy asks for. Go to the alley, start a game of bowling there, and bowl your frames — the trophy is tied to that specific alley, not to bowling anywhere else.

steps.text: Travel to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Start a game of bowling at the alley
Bowl your throws with a clean follow-through
Finish the game so the trophy registers

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description points at a moment between the two partners, and partner moments belong to the stretches where the pair are together — take the opportunity during an early shared section rather than assuming it returns later.
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately coy: a partnership moment with mass appeal. Read it as a shared beat between the two protagonists that plays out in public — when the story puts the pair together in front of a crowd or an audience, lean into the joint activity it offers and see it through to the end.

steps.text: Play the sections where both protagonists are together
Take the joint public activity the game offers the pair
See the moment through to its conclusion
Check the trophy has registered before moving on

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This one tracks the choices you make through the game, for better or worse. There is no single place to earn it: take the decision points the story and the world offer instead of skipping them, and the tracked count of choices builds across the whole playthrough.

steps.text: Take decision points as the story and world present them
Do not skip optional choices — each one feeds the count
Keep making choices through missions and free roam
Let the tracked choices accumulate until the trophy pops

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: 'Second time's the charm' means failing once and succeeding on the retry — if the moment is a one-off scripted attempt, reloading an old save to skip the failure can lock it, so retry in the moment instead.
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed at it the second time. The honest reading of the description is a fail-then-retry beat: when an attempt goes wrong — a race, a job, a challenge — do not reload or walk away; run it again straight away and succeed on that second try.

steps.text: Attempt an activity or job and let a first attempt fail naturally
Retry the same attempt immediately instead of reloading
Succeed on the second attempt
Confirm the trophy registers on the successful retry

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A strange one-off encounter is the classic missable shape — when something odd appears in the world, chase it there and then instead of assuming it will still be there after the story.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description is a reaction, not an instruction, which points at one of the world's odd encounters — an unexplained sight or event out in Leonida. Explore off the main roads, follow up anything that looks out of place, and when the strange moment starts, stay and watch it play out.

steps.text: Explore beyond the main roads and mission markers
Investigate anything that looks out of place in the world
Stay with the strange encounter until it concludes
Let the trophy register once the moment ends

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle — a drive-by swing, not a shot. Ride or drive past a target at modest speed and use the melee attack as you pass so they go down like a bowling pin; a crowded pavement gives you the easiest setup.

steps.text: Get on or in a vehicle you can melee from
Ride past a target at a controlled speed
Use the melee attack as you pass to knock them down
Make sure the knockdown, not a collision, does the work

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from scores that pay in dirty money; take them to the contacts who clean money and keep the loop running — pick up bills, launder them, repeat — until the laundered total crosses a quarter of a million.

steps.text: Take scores that pay out in marked bills
Deliver the bills to a contact who launders money
Repeat the loop, banking each laundered payout
Reach $250,000 earned from laundering

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the game's shops in total. It is lifetime spending, not one spree: vehicles, weapons, clothes, food and services all feed it, so spend naturally as you play and top it up with a vehicle or property purchase if you are close at the end.

steps.text: Buy what you need from shops as you play
Spread spending across different shops, not just one
Track your lifetime spend in the game stats
Cross $100,000 of total spending

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property on the map. Garages are bought from their property markers once you can afford them, so build your bank balance first — heists and laundering feed it — then tour the map buying each garage until none are left for sale.

steps.text: Build the money to afford property through scores and jobs
Visit a garage property marker and buy the garage
Repeat at each remaining garage across Leonida
Buy the final garage to own them all

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a vehicle you want to keep, open the app and register it on the spot; ten registrations build up quickly once you make it a habit with every new ride instead of a chore at the end.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app with your first vehicle
Register the vehicle to the app
Register each new vehicle as you acquire it
Reach ten registered vehicles
